answer_1.quote: One such widely studied task is image captioning which provides a textual description T given an image I. In contrast, visual storytelling is the task of generating a sequence of textual descriptions ({T1, T2, ..., Tn}) from a sequence of images ({I1, I2, ..., In}).

answer_2.quote: The automatic metrics are evaluated using BLEU , METEOR and ROUGE L .

answer_4.quote: We also conducted human evaluation (interface in Figure ) in the form of preference testing comparing our V-Infill model with XE by randomly sampling 10 recipes. Among 20 evaluators, our V-Infill model is preferred 64% of the times over the XE model on an average.
answer_4.guideline: Preference testing where annotators pick the more preferred generated recipe for each image sequence.
